text: Paper and book atlas / 1960 Cooling of the Interstellar Clouds in Region of Neutral Hydrogen Takayanagi & Nishimura · 1960 PASJ 12, 77–105 Source rates audited · truncated model H₂ rotational excitation and the cooling budget of neutral clouds. Scope in this archive. 34 printed upward H + para-H2 rates audited on p. 82; a truncated steady level calculation is compared with 60 printed cooling values. Twelve numerical checks pass, while the largest Table 2 discrepancy is retained at about 21.72%. Source review: Title p. 77, Table 1 and Eq. 7 p. 82, Eq. 9, energy and Table 2 p. 83 visually reviewed. Figures, calculations and validation.
